$schema-note: The desktop companion's words: the window (ui/copy.js), the tray, the install windows and the Go side's headline, addon row and failure messages (keys companion.*). Same grammar as en.json; only the companion targets (companion/internal/copygen and companion/ui/copy_gen.js) read this file. Run node web/scripts/gen-mobile-copy.mjs after editing.

strings.companion.version.takesEffect: takes effect at your next login
strings.companion.headline.connectingTitle: Waiting for you to sign in…

strings.companion.headline.advancedOffSub: Reports will miss deaths with health, item level, resources and positions.

strings.companion.headline.advancedRowHelp: Turn it on in Options > System > Network > Advanced Combat Logging.

strings.companion.headline.loggingSub: Uploading your fights as they end

strings.companion.connect.denied: You pressed Cancel on the site. Nothing was connected.
strings.companion.connect.expired: The sign-in link expired after 10 minutes.
strings.companion.failure.badCode: That code is not valid. A code works once and expires after 10 minutes. Get a new one on the site.
strings.companion.failure.emptyCode: Paste the code from the site first.
strings.companion.failure.offline: Could not reach foreversixty.gg. Check your connection and try again.
strings.companion.failure.server: The site had a problem. Try again in a minute.
strings.companion.failure.save: Connected, but this PC would not let the companion save the sign-in. Nothing will upload. Details are in logs/companion.log.
strings.companion.failure.notWoW: That folder is not a World of Warcraft folder. Forever Sixty runs on WoW Forever; pick its _forever_ folder.
strings.companion.failure.knownFolder: That folder is already in the list.
strings.companion.failure.noPicker: The companion could not open a folder dialog on this computer.
strings.companion.failure.noCharacter: Choose a character from the list.
strings.companion.failure.settings: Could not save the settings. Details are in logs/companion.log.
strings.companion.failure.noConnect: There is no sign-in in progress.
strings.companion.failure.badURL: That link cannot be opened from here.
strings.companion.failure.badRequest: The companion could not read that request.
strings.companion.failure.notAdded: That folder was found automatically, so there is nothing to remove.
strings.companion.failure.notPaired: Sign in first. There is nothing to check until this computer is connected.
strings.companion.failure.internal: The companion hit a problem. Details are in logs/companion.log.
strings.companion.failure.gameRunning: Close World of Warcraft first, then try again. The companion does not change addon files while the game is running.
strings.companion.failure.addonDownload: The companion could not get the addon. Check your connection and try again in a minute.
strings.companion.failure.addonInstall: The addon could not be installed, and your game folder was left as it was. Details are in logs/companion.log.
